title: Eva Mendes embraces her new London life in knee-high boots and a sweatshirt dress - NewsBreak
text:
By Daniel Neira ,
6 hours ago As Hollywood star Eva Mendes enjoys a quieter chapter of life in London with partner Ryan Gosling, she’s proving that relaxed European living hasn’t dulled her signature sense of style.
The actress was spotted strolling through Notting Hill, looking radiant and unbothered as she ran errands between skincare appointments and organic shopping.
© Goff Photos/The Grosby Group Eva visited Daylesford farm shop after stopping by Keren Bartov skin care clinic. Dressed in an oversized olive-green sweatshirt dress, Eva embraced autumn’s casual-chic vibe with grace. The understated silhouette offered both comfort and modern flair, ideal for a day that included a stop at the upscale Keren Bartov skincare clinic and a visit to the beloved Daylesford farm shop.
She elevated the cozy look with knee-high cognac leather boots, a bold choice that added some Western sophistication to the otherwise minimal outfit.
© Goff Photos/The Grosby Group Eva Mendes embraces her new London life in knee-high boots and a sweatshirt dress Eva completed the look with a blush pink baseball cap featuring a vintage-style graphic, oversized tortoiseshell sunglasses, and a slouchy olive tote bag that effortlessly coordinated with her dress.
© Goff Photos/The Grosby Group Eva and husband Ryan Gosling moved to the UK earlier this year. A denim jacket, carried casually under her arm, hinted at the classic cool-girl layers we expect from the star, especially in London’s ever-changing weather.
While Eva and Ryan reportedly returned to the US earlier this year, the couple had fully embraced life in the UK while Ryan filmed his upcoming sci-fi film 'Project Hail' in Surrey. During their time in London, they settled into a charming Victorian townhouse in Notting Hill, a neighborhood Eva described as “magical” in a rare interview with The Sunday Times.
© Goff Photos/The Grosby Group Eva Mendes is seen running errands in Notting Hill on September 15, 2025. The actress even gave fans a few glimpses into their serene London lifestyle via social media. One standout moment featured Eva lounging on a sun-dappled garden terrace, framed by potted olive trees and lush greenery.
© Getty Images While Eva and Ryan reportedly returned to the US earlier this year, the couple had fully embraced life in the UK while Ryan filmed his upcoming sci-fi film 'Project Hail' Eva’s recent public reflections have made her more relatable than ever. She’s opened up about the challenges of motherhood, sharing honest moments of vulnerability while raising daughters Esmeralda, 10, and Amada, 8. “I don't like myself when I yell,” she confessed on the Parenting & You podcast, candidly addressing the pressures of balancing home life with career demands.
Despite the spotlight, Eva remains famously private. Her relationship with Gosling, which began in 2011, is mostly kept out of public view, and while the pair reportedly married in 2016, they’ve never confirmed it. Fans have come to admire her thoughtful presence, strong values, and, of course, her effortlessly elegant style.
